Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup  ·  Date: October 17, 2026

You asked us to move the store from Jimdo to Shopify and rebuild it properly: storefront and mobile, content and service pages, blog, PDF downloads, forms, navigation, search, shipping, SEO and launch. This document gives you three ways to do it, what each includes, what we need from you, and what is still open before we can fix the price.

Option 3 costs the most because every category layout on your site is different and each one needs its own Shopify template. Options 1 and 2 use one layout, which is also easier for your team to maintain after launch.

2.1 Category pages

TodayTransfer Tape: a product block, then a long product description sitting in the category page (red box).

TodayDigital Media / FDC: a grid of family buttons that jump to anchors further down the page.

TodayDigital Laminates / 3M: section headings and anchor buttons mixed with product blocks (red boxes).

These are three of the layouts; there are more. In Options 1 and 2 they all become one Shopify collection layout: product grid, filters, and the category intro text on top. In Option 3 we rebuild each layout as its own template. Anchor links inside long pages work differently on Shopify, so some jumps may need to become links to separate pages; we confirm page by page.

2.2 "Online Store" page and product pages

On Online Store, a product click sends the shopper to an anchor on a category page, because there are no product pages. Shopify gives every product its own page, which is also better for Google. In Options 1 and 2 the click opens that page. Option 3 keeps today's behaviour.

3

Redesign (Option 2)

We design three pages: homepage, collection page and product page. Blog, article, content and contact pages use the theme's templates, which already look clean.

3.1 Homepage

A starting layout, adjusted once we work with your content: hero slider, services, featured categories, featured products, promo banner, customer testimonials, latest blog posts.

3.2 Imagery

TodayCartoon-style graphics like this one look less professional. We'd use photos of real signs, wraps and jobs your customers have produced.

3.3 Collection and product page

Collection pages get filters (category, brand, finish, width, and similar), set up with Shopify's free Search & Discovery app. For products sold wholesale, the product page can use an add-to-cart layout like the one below.

ReferenceAdd-to-cart layout on another store (not your site): every variant in one list with its own quantity, then one Add to cart.

4

Products, shipping and checkout

4.1 Products with many options

Shopify supports a product with 147 variants. If the product has 147 options rather than variants, it needs an options app. We haven't found that product on the site yet, so please send us its link (§5, Q1).

4.2 Shipping

RequirementHow we handle it
Freight-included rollsMust not be charged shipping a second time, including in mixed carts
Weight-based US ratesNative Shopify rates by weight
Mixed cartsDepends on the exact rule (§5, Q2)
Oversized, Alaska/HawaiiDepends on the exact rule; may need a shipping app
Local pickupNative Shopify local pickup at your Youngstown address
Shipping rules decide part of the price. Please send us the full rules (§5, Q2). If Shopify's built-in settings cover them, setup is included at no extra cost. If they need a shipping app or custom logic, we quote that separately before we start it.

4.3 Terms accounts

We recommend the setup for your existing terms accounts once we know how they work today (§5, Q3).

4.4 Payments and tax

You connect PayPal and your payment provider, and enter tax registrations, because they hold your banking and tax credentials (§8). We guide you through each step and test checkout.

Minimum access

A Shopify collaborator request (you approve it; no password shared), Jimdo login or an export for the migration, and user access to GA4, Search Console and Merchant Center. We don't need your registrar, PayPal or bank logins. We ask you to remove our access after the support month ends.

We can go through this on a call if that's easier.
